query: Oracle fiscal year end date and fiscal quarter dates
normalized: date dates end fiscal oracle quarter year

output.content:
Oracle’s fiscal year ends on **May 31** and runs from **June 1 through May 31**. [[1]]

- **Q1:** June 1–August 31 
- **Q2:** September 1–November 30 
- **Q3:** December 1–February 28 (February 29 in leap years) 
- **Q4:** March 1–May 31 [[2]] 

For example, Oracle’s FY2026 ran from June 1, 2025, through May 31, 2026. [[1]]

sources.title: What is the Fiscal Year for Oracle? Fiscal Year Calendar & Quarterly Schedule
